item.title: Ojiya: The Birthplace of Nishikigoi Ornamental Koi — Guide
item.description: Ojiya is recognised as the birthplace of nishikigoi, the vividly coloured ornamental koi carp prized by collectors worldwide as ‘swimming jewels,’ first developed by local rice farmers roughly 200 years ago who noticed and selectively bred colour mutations among their food-fish carp. Today the city’s mountain ponds continue to produce some of the world’s most prized koi bloodlines, and the Nishikigoi no Sato museum and viewing facility lets visitors learn the history and admire prize-winning specimens up close.
